create_row_section: create a RowSection to display multiple report sections side-by-side with a title and optional anchor
build_row_section_collapsible: build a collapsible RowSection with a list of child ReportSection instances and a description
test_row_section_header_includes: test the RowSection header_includes method to collect header includes from all child sections
review_row_section_get_context: review the RowSection get_context method that returns title, anchor, and description as a dictionary
summarize_row_section_template: summarize the RowSection template_filename property that returns 'row.html' for Jinja2 rendering
